content.short: Clearpool is an onchain credit marketplace for institutional borrowing, private credit, and tokenized real-world yield products.
content.description: Clearpool is an onchain credit marketplace focused on institutional borrowing and real-world yield. Its official docs describe products including Dynamic pools for permissionless lending to whitelisted borrowers, Prime for KYC and AML screened institutional credit, and newer private credit and PayFi products tied to tokenized yield. The protocol is built to connect lenders with professional borrowers through smart contract based pools rather than overcollateralized retail lending models. On Mantle, Clearpool fits as credit and yield infrastructure for users seeking exposure to institutional financing flows.
